card.name: Linking words before organization names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "to", "by" and ")" just before the name of an organization, council, or program in web text about institutions and development. It also fires on list markers before a named theme.

modes.label: Role then organization
modes.description: The word "of" after a title like chair or president, right before an organization name.
modes.example: He is board chair<< of>> YES! Magazine, co-chair of the

modes.label: Verb or agent link
modes.description: "to" or "by" before a named agency or a promoted aim in news about UN bodies.
modes.example: ILO seeks<< to>> promote human and labour rights by establishing international

modes.label: List marker before theme
modes.description: A closing parenthesis after a number, right before a named conference theme.
modes.example: and 2<<)>> the Institutional Framework for Sustainable Development.
